name: Orbit Room
summary:
See Earth’s orbital environment from a new perspective.

Orbit Room turns satellite and space-debris data into an interactive VR exhibition. Move around a globe filled with orbital paths, select objects to view explanations, change simulation speed, and compare different regions of near-Earth space.

Explore two interactive exhibits. Each presents a different view of the orbital environment, helping you understand the scale, distribution, and movement of satellites and debris around Earth.
